ValidationRule.description: Enforces the In Network, Baptist Health Network, and Curachoice Network fields being checked when the Medical Group field is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), Medical_Group__c, OR( NOT(IsInNetwork__c), NOT(Baptist_Health_Network__c), NOT(BH_Curaechoice_Network__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must uncheck the Medical Group option before you can uncheck any of the Network fields.
